Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the third innings! A tricky little phase for the Kiwi opening batters. The players of Bangladesh stride out to the middle, followed by Tom Latham and Will Young who walk out to bat for New Zealand. Taskin Ahmed to start with the ball.
...Third innings...

Well, New Zealand had to toil hard in the middle to get those 10 wickets and they must be drained out. All of their pace bowlers bowled more than 30 overs and they had to work hard for their wickets as the tourists showed great fight. In the end, Trent Boult finished with 4 wickets to his name, while Neil Wagner picked up 3. However, it was Tim Southee who looked the most promising bowler in the first session on Day 4 and he picked up a couple. The Kiwis now have their task cut out as they trail by 130 runs and their batters need to start well. Will Tom Latham lead from the front in the second innings? We'll find that soon. Do join us for the third innings which begins shortly.

Bangladesh have batted really well and most importantly, it hasn't been a one-man show. All of their batters have chipped in and that has resulted in them posting a huge total on the board. The only thing that didn't go their way is that none of their batters managed to get a hundred. However, Mominul Haque will be more than pleased with the way they have replied to New Zealand's first innings score.

End of a brilliant innings for Bangladesh and they would be extremely pleased with their effort. They have batted their skins out against the Kiwis and they would have certainly taken this score at the start of the Test. They are in the driver's seat now and the hosts are in a spot of bother.

We are set for Day 4 to get underway! The players of New Zealand stride out to the middle and they are followed by Bangladesh's overnight batters, Yasir Ali and Mehidy Hasan. Rachin Ravindra will start with the ball.

New Zealand bowlers bowled their hearts out on Day 3 but it was only Trent Boult and Neil Wagner who managed to get into the wickets column. Surprisingly, the Kiwis have bowled 156 overs so far and yet they haven't been able to take those 10 wickets, especially in home conditions. This sums up the entire story and also tells us how well the tourists have batted against the pace attack of New Zealand. The Kiwi bowlers would be a bit weary coming into Day 4 but they will need to make sure that they get the remaining wickets without conceding too many runs if they are to have any chance of winning this Test. Lots of things to look forward to on Day 4 which promises to be a cracker. Stay tuned for further updates.

Bangladesh have made their intentions very clear in the first Test by putting on a show with the bat and they are firmly in the driver's seat now. Their top order has done a terrific job of batting out time as well as piling up runs as the number of runs scored in the first innings decide the outcome of the match more often than not. The tourists now have a decent lead but the overnight batters will be eager to bat long and score as many runs as possible so that they get a substantial lead which will also ensure that New Zealand do not get a chance to come back into the contest.

Hello and a very warm welcome to the coverage of Day 4 of the first Test between New Zealand and Bangladesh. So far, we have witnessed enthralling 3 days of Test cricket and we go into Day 4 with the tourists having the edge over the Kiwis. Yes, you read that right. It is Bangladesh who lead by 73 runs in the first innings and the hosts need to make sure that Bangladesh do not run away with the lead on Day 4.
... Day 4, Session 1 ...

Right then. Bangladesh have batted really well to cut down the deficit and would just aim to get as many runs as possible on the morning of Day 4. The action continues on Tuesday at 3.30 am IST (10.00 pm GMT, previous day). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Till then, take care and goodbye!

A late joy for the hosts, as they saw the backs of the two set batters in the final session, thanks to Trent Boult. The bowlers were made to toil really hard today and these couple of wickets would make them happy but not enough as the visitors kept piling on the pressure with every run, they put on the scoreboard. The Kiwis would look to pick up the remaining wickets quickly and come out to bat as soon as possible.

This has been the longest ever Test innings played by Bangladesh overseas. This tells you everything about their batting performance today. Even though they lost two scalps in the morning session. Haque and Das made sure they get the repair work done and get their noses in front. The pair batted throughout the second session and would’ve loved to repeat the same in the final session but that was not the case. Both the batsmen were sent back in their 80s and would be absolutey gutted. Later though, Mehidy Hasan and Yasir Ali scored at a brisk rate and ended their day without losing any more wickets.

New Zealand tried everything out of the box, but Bangladesh batters had all the answers and negotiated really well with the blade. But in the final hour of the final session, Boult put his hand up and struck in quick succession to get rid of both the set batters, Mominul Haque and Liton Das. But Bangladesh have done really well to keep the runs ticking and extend their lead to 73 runs.

The hosts have been completely outplayed here, they failed to grab any wickets in this session and are in desperate need of a wicket. Mominul Haque and Liton Das have looked calm and composed. After a noteworthy batting performance on Day 2, Bangladesh have been all over the place here. They could not find their rhythm out there in the middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy played an impressive knock, but he was unable to hold on to his innings and make it big. Mominul Haque is struggling but is still out there in the middle. Bangladesh trail by 108 runs and one big partnership is all that they need to get things under control.

An exceptional bowling performance from New Zealand. They did not allow the batters to score freely, kept adding pressure, and most importantly grabbed two important scalps. Neil Wagner was the man to dismiss Mahmudul Hasan Joy, soon Trent Boult followed that with a peach of a delivery to dismiss Mushfiqur Rahim. Although, Kyle Jamieson might have not picked up a wicket, but he was right on the money. He certainly put up an impactful performance with the ball. New Zealand will come into the next session with some confidence and will be hoping to grab a few more wickets.

That was an exciting session of Test cricket. New Zealand have come back stronger and picked up 2 scalps in the session. They will be mighty pleased with their performance this morning. The visitors on the other hand, will not be satisfied with their show. They only have managed to add 45 runs in this session, and have lost their experienced player, Mushfiqur Rahim and Mahmudul Hasan Joy who was looking in fine touch.

FOUR! Another boundary for Liton Das! Tim Southee drops it short, on middle. Liton Das hangs back and pulls it past the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Liton Das taps it towards point.
FOUR! Glorious drive! Tim Southee overpitches this one, outside off. Liton Das leans and drives it past covers for a boundary.
Fuller, on the off pole. Liton Das pushes it towards mid off.
Much straighter this time, on a length. Liton Das flicks it past backward square leg for a single.
Trent Boult goes over the wicket now, serves a length ball, outside off. Liton guides it towards point.

Touch fuller, darting it onto the pads. Liton Das tucks it square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Good-length ball, outside off. Liton Das hangs back and blocks it watchfully.
Nipping it back in onto the pads. Liton Das misses his flick and gets hit high on the pads.
Outside off, on a length. Mominul Haque leaves it alone.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Tim Southee serves a full ball, outside off. Mominul Haque leans and looks to drives that, but manages to get a thick outside edge past gully for four.
Full, swinging it in. Mominul Haque looks to defend but gets an inside edge that hits the deck and bounces over the stumps.
Length, outside off. Mominul Haque leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Mominul Haque hangs back and punches it towards point.
Length ball, nipping back in. Mominul Haque misses his glance and gets hit on pads.
Length ball, outside off. Liton Das, on back foot, blocks it. End of a successful over.

The ball goes through and knocks the middle stump over.
Full, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leans and drives it towards cover.
Length, on middle. Blocked out.
Fuller this time, outside off. Mominul Haque taps it towards point.

Good-length delivery, on the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it towards fine leg through the inner half of his bat.
Short again, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone again.
Fuller in length, shaping it away from outside the off stump. Mushfiqur Rahim leans and shoulders arms to it.

A full length this time, on the pads. Mominul Haque flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Too short this time, around middle. Mominul Haque ducks underneath it and lets that go through.
Back of a length, outside off. Mominul Haque leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mominul Haque pushes it to point.
Back of a length, outside off. Mominul Haque lets that go through.
Full, on the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
A fuller ball, outside off, shaping it away this time. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone.
A length ball, down the leg side again. Mushfiqur Rahim goes for the flick once again and misses it altogether.
An inswinger this time but this down the leg side. Mushfiqur Rahim looks to flick this but fails to get any bat.
Fuller, outside off, an outswinger. Mushfiqur Rahim offers no shot.
A length ball, outside off, at 125.1 clicks. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone.
Length, outside off. Mominul Haque hangs back and defends it out.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mominul Haque, on back foot, blocks it out.
Fuller, around the off stump channel. Mominul Haque pushes it back to the bowler.
Trent Boult drops it a touch shorter this time, outside off. Mominul Haque gets an inside edge on to his pads.
Touch fuller this time, outside off. Mominul Haque lunges and blocks it.
Back of a length, outside off. Mominul Haque hangs back and pushes that past point for a brace. That brings up the 200 for Bangladesh!
Length ball, swinging it away outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim chops it towards cover.
Another good length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out off the back foot.
On a length, outside off. Left alone.
Sharp bouncer, down the leg side. Mushfiqur Rahim ducks underneath that one.
Touch shorter this time, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim, on back foot, blocks it out.
A length ball, outside off. Mominul Haque pushes it towards covers and scampers through to the other end.
Good-length delivery, swinging it on the pads this time. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it to square leg.
Short ball, outside off. Left alone.
LEG BYE! Good-length ball, on the pads. Mominul Haque looks to flick but misses and the ball brushes off his pads and rolls towards fine leg. The batters steal a leg bye here.
Length ball, on the pads. Mominul Haque blocks it out on the leg side.
Touch fuller, around the pad, nipping it back in this time. Mushfiqur Rahim works it towards fine leg for a single.
Boult serves it o tad fuller, outside off, at 129 clicks. Mushfiqur Rahim leans and shoulders arms to it.
Tim Southee serves another full-length ball, outside off. Mominul Haque drives it to the man at mid off. A dot to end the over.
Fuller length again, around the off pole. Mominul Haque, on front foot, blocks it solidly.
Fuller again, outside off. Mominul Haque lunges and blocks it out.
Touch fuller, darting it on the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim leans and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Another length ball, shaping it away outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it towards cover.
Tim Southee starts off with a length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leaves it alone.
DRINKS! New Zealand have done well in the first hour, they have up-picked an early wicket and trying to some pressure on Bangladesh.
Swinging it away, outside off. Mominul Haque offers no shot on that.
Full and on offf. Mominul Haque blocks that but gets an inside edge back to the pads.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mominul Haque leaves it alone.
On a length, swinging it onto the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it to square leg for a single.
Touch shorter, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim shoulders arms to it.
Trent Boult starts off with a length ball, around off, Rahim defends that one.
New Zealand have taken the second new ball now. Trent Boult will bowl with the new ball.
And again! This time it was even closer to the outside edge. Neil Wagner serves a length ball, outside off. Mominul Haque looks to block that, but gets beaten as the ball drifts away a tad bit.
Beaten! Length ball, outside off. Mominul Haque looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.

Full, outside off. Mominul Haque gets an outside edge towards gully.

Loopy delivery, on middle. Mominul Haque leans and pushes it to short fine.

Length, down the leg side this time. Mominul Haque gets on top of it and blocks it out.

Beaten! Kyle Jamieson serves a shorter one, just outside off. Mominul Haque looks to defend but gets beaten as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.

Shorter again, slanting across. Mushfiqur Rahim gets low and will leave it alone.
Length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out.

Length, on middle. Mominul Haque, on back foot, blocks it out.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mominul Haque shoulders arms to it.
Tad fuller, outside off. Mominul Haque leans and defends it out on the off side.
A length ball, around off. Blocked out.
Beaten! A length ball, around the fourth stump line. Mominul Haque looks to defend but gets beaten past the outside edge.

DROPPED! A tough chance goes down! Kyle Jamieson serves a fuller one, onto the pads. Mominul Haque closes the face of the bat and looks to flick, but gets a leading edge towards the bowler. Kyle Jamieson dives to his right and gets his hand to it but fails to collect it.
Back of a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim bends and leaves it alone.
A fuller length, much straighter this time, on the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it towards deep square leg for a brace.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim defends that one solidly.

Fuller, on middle. Mominul Haque pushes it back to the bowler.
A length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim offers no shot on that.
Short, on the body. Blocked out.

Back of a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim shoulders arms to it.
Short in length, around leg. Mushfiqur Rahim taps it towards short fine.
Length ball, on middle. Mominul Haque blocks it solidly. A maiden for Kyle Jamieson!
Back of a length, outside off. Mominul Haque leaves it alone.
Length ball, outside off. Mominul Haque offers no shot on that.
Shorter outside off. Mominul Haque punches it towards point.
Length, on middle. Blocked out.
Kyle Jamieson serves a length ball, outside off. Mominul Haque leaves that alone, that came back in sharply.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out to the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! This is just what New Zealand needed. Neil Wagner strikes yet again and sends Mahmudul Hasan Joy back to the hut. Neil Wagner serves a short delivery, wide of off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy could have let this one go, but instead, he goes to chop this on the off side but could not get hold of this one and manages to just chip it to Henry Nicholls at gully, who takes an easy catch there. New Zealand have an early breakthrough and Neil Wagner has his third wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Henry Nicholls b Neil Wagner

Wide! Short, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy just bends a tad bit and lets it go over him. A wide called as gone over the batsman.
Swing and a miss! Neil Wagner serves a shorter one, outside off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy swings hard it but gets beaten as the ball drifts away from him.
Full, outside off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy leans and drives it through covers. Two runs taken.
Touch fuller this time, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards gully.
Good-length delivery, nipping back in on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy defends that one.
Length, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy taps it towards fine leg. A single to finish the over.
Beaten! A length delivery, outside off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy lunges and goes for the drive but gets beaten on the past edge.
Touch shorter this time, outside off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy shoulders arms to it.
Pulling his length back this time, A length delivery, outside off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy blocks it out.

Full, on off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy defends that one.
Kyle Jamieson will bowl from the other end.
Shaping it away this time, outside off. Mominul Haque leaves that alone.

Good-length delivery, on middle. Mahmudul Hasan Joy blocks it out.
Length delivery, outside off. Left alone.

We are ready for live action! Mominul Haque and Mahmudul Hasan Joy walks out to the middle. Followed by the New Zealand players who take the field.
Neil Wagner starts off with a fullish delivery, down the leg side. Mahmudul Hasan Joy goes for the flick but misses.

The World Test Champions had an off day, they lost quick wickets and were restricted to a score below 350, their bowlers too were not at their best. They would be hoping to pick up some early wickets in the day and put the pressure back on Bangladesh. The visitors have been exceptional so far, Mahmudul Hasan Joy and Shanto have given them the desired start. Mahmudul Hasan Joy is still out there and will be looking to carry the same kind of form. A lot of cricket still left in this game.

Hello and a warm welcome to Day 3 of this intriguing Test between New Zealand and Bangladesh. It's been a tough battle between the two sides so far, but Day 2 completely belonged to the visitors. They would be looking to continue the same way. While New Zealand will be looking for some quick wickets and take things under control.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

Right then. Bangladesh have their noses in front and would hope to continue on their merry way. While, the Kiwis will be looking forward for the second new ball to trouble the batters. The action continues on Monday at 3.30 am IST (10.00 pm GMT, previous day). Till then take care and goodbye.

Not the day New Zealand would like! Traditionally, in New Zealand, teams always struggle to bat first and the team batting second gets the best of the pitches to bat on. However, given the home side's dominance in the last few years, it has managed to post totals in excess of 400 consistently while batting first and dismiss oppositions under 200 if bowling first. 2022 has not quite gone to that plan yet.Their bowlers toiled really hard in the sun but the batters were always up for the task and negotiated really well. But it was Wagner yet again who came to the rescue and broke a crucial partnership in the middle. The hosts would’ve thought they had a sniff but were not able to capitalize on it. Neil Wagner was the star of the pack for the Kiwis. The hosts would hope the moving day swings in their favour.

Bangladesh would've loved to see Shanto and Joy to see off the day but the former was sent back. Although, Joy and Haque made sure they do not loose any more wickets till Stumps. The runs came in at a brisk rate for the visitors and had some luck riding along with them. They now trail by 153 runs and the wicket is a friendly pitch to bat on as well. The batters would be eager to come out in the morning on Day 3.

End of a really good day for Bangladesh. It was their bowlers who set the tone and their batters continued the momentum. New Zealand were not able to cause much problems for the batters and Bangladesh batters cruised on this wicket.

Oh boy! That was close! Good-length ball, on middle, nipping back in. Mominul Haque looks to defend but gets beaten on the inside edge. He gets thudded on the pads. Loud shout for an lbw but the umpire says no. New Zealand players discuss whether to take the review or not and in the end, decides against it. Replay shows that the ball was going over the stumps. So good decision not to take the review. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 2!
On a good length, around off, coming back in. Mominul Haque watches the ball closely and make a leave. Finally getting the radar right is Kyle Jamieson.
Much better! Good-length ball, outside off. Mominul Haque offers no shot.
Same again! Kyle Jamieson is not able to get his radar right from 'round the wicket. Another length ball, going down leg. Left alone.
Sprays this one down leg. Mominul Haque looks to flick but misses. Tim Southee at second slip appeals for a catch but there was nothing on it.
Back of a length, on middle. Mominul Haque blocks it on the leg side.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls an in-angler, on middle and leg. Mahmudul Hasan Joy looks to defend but misses and gets struck on the thigh pad.

He is riding his luck now. That was inches away from hitting the off stump. Well, he has been batting brilliantly and deserves a little bit of luck perhaps.

Outside off, on a length, Mominul Haque lets it through.

Full and on off. Mahmudul Hasan Joy defends it out.

Good length, on leg. Joy clips it to mid-wikcet for a single.
Good-length ball, on off, Joy defends it to mid-wicket.

Outside off, shaping away. Haque leaves it alone.
Length and on off. Haque blocks it out.

Back of a length, on the hips. Joy flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Five runs have been awarded to Bangladesh. The ball fell short of Ross Taylor at first slip. It ricochets off his hands and goes onto hit the grill of the helmet. Bonus runs for Bangladesh.

FIVE RUNS! A dream ball this one. A length ball, outside off. Haque hangs his blade away from his body. The ball takes the outside edge and lands short of the man at first slip. The ball goes off his hands and goes on to hit the helmet behind the keeper. The umpire has awarded 5 runs for Bangladesh.

Just the breakthrough New Zealand were looking for and Neil Wagner doesn't disappoint.
Commentary.Howout: c Will Young b Neil Wagner

DRINKS! Bangladesh have done really well in this session so far. The pair of Shanto and Joy have stitched a solid partnership and would love to remain unscathed till the Stumps. Session Summary - 28 overs, 65 runs, 1 wicket. What an entertaining session! A good mix of attack and defence and ultimately, the session goes in favor of Bangladesh. Shadman Islam and Mahmudul Hasan Joy were motoring along really well and started to build a good partnership. But just when the partnership was blossoming, Neil Wagner scalped the wicket of Shadman Islam to provide New Zealand the breakthrough they were looking for. He bowled probing lines and lengths but was the only one to trouble the batters as he lacked support from the other end and that allowed Mahmudul Hasan Joy and Najmul Hossain Shanto to settle and bat the session out. There is still enough from the pitch to assist both, batters and bowlers. Should be a lively final session. Do join us at 8.30 am IST (3 am GMT) for that.

A team performance by the visitors! Bangladesh needed five wickets and it did not take much time for them to bowl out New Zealand at 328 runs. All thanks to Mehidy Hasan. He was the star with the ball, as he picked up three wickets. This wouldn't have been possible without the early strike by Shoriful Islam. The onus is now on their batters to see of the next session without losing any wickets. But the Kiwis have a really solid arsenal when it comes to the bowling department. An enthralling session of cricket awaits. Do join us at 6.10 am IST (12.40 am GMT) for the second session.

The Kiwi batters fought till the very end. It was Conway and Young who built a solid foundation. Young slipped out after his half-ton while Conway snatched his first ton at home. Later, Nicholls played a crucial knock to make sure to cross the 300-run mark. New Zealand lost 5 wickets for just 70 runs. This tells you the story of their innings.

The first session clearly belonged to the visitors. First, they bowled out New Zealand before Lunch and later they managed to remain unscathed till the break. New Zealand could not add on their tally with the blade.
